worldcombat.skill.earthpower.summary: Make the ground under the target erupt from below: it hits only grounded foes, dealing special damage and launching them up, and may lower their Sp. Def by 1 stage. Airborne targets pass above the surge. A small patch of ground beneath the target is torn open.
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.use.0: Strike a grounded target from range through its feet
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.use.1: Launch a point-blank foe off the ground
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.use.2: Skip fliers and drifters, punish planted foes
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.use.3: Leave torn ground beneath the target
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.description: Every grounded foe within %1$s blocks of the target's feet is caught and launched upward at %2$s blocks per tick.
It has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
Wind-up %1$s (the foe's window to step away), range %2$s blocks, tears last %3$s, about %4$s cells torn and %5$s clods thrown; fissure is currently %6$s.
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.earthpower.growth.0: From level %1$s the surge rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
On: burst radius ×1.4, torn cells ×1.6 and clods ×1.3, but power ×0.88 and +4 ticks cooldown — covers a small patch around the target's feet. Off: a narrower, harder single column for naming one target.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it raise the ground under more distant targets.
On: slow-moving targets rank higher, since the surge rises at their feet and a still target is least likely to step out while the mark shows. Off: every target ranks the same.
